In the upcoming NFL football game between Panthers and Saints, scheduled for November 15 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Panthers" if the Panthers win the game by 8 or more points.

In the upcoming NFL football game between Seahawks and Raiders, scheduled for November 15 at 4:05PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Seahawks" if Seahawks win the game.
This market will resolve to "Raiders" if Raiders win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Seahawks and Raiders, scheduled for November 15 at 4:05PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Seahawks" if Seahawks win the game.
This market will resolve to "Raiders" if Raiders win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

markets.referenceNote: Polymarket exchange reference; verify Caesars line, price and void rules

teamAlerts.name: Kirk Cousins
teamAlerts.detail: Cousins completed 22 of 32 passes for 216 yards, one touchdown and three interceptions in Sunday's 38-17 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed twice for no gain and scored a rushing touchdown.

teamAlerts.name: Aidan O'Connell
teamAlerts.detail: O'Connell (coach's decision) is inactive and serving as the Raiders' emergency third quarterback Sunday versus San Francisco.

teamAlerts.name: Fernando Mendoza
teamAlerts.detail: Mendoza didn't play in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

teamAlerts.name: Drew Lock
teamAlerts.detail: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said after Sunday's 17-3 win over the Cardinals that Lock sustained an oblique injury during the game, leaving Lock's availability for Week 10 against the Raiders up in the air, Bob Condotta of the Seattle Times reports.

teamAlerts.name: Sam Darnold
teamAlerts.detail: Darnold (quadriceps) may miss Seattle's Week 10 game at Las Vegas, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

teamAlerts.name: Jalen Milroe
teamAlerts.detail: Milroe will get added reps at practice ahead of Sunday's matchup with the Cardinals, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.
